description: A Java class implementing an Android TextToSpeechService that generates synthetic 'speech' for a robot, supporting multiple languages with custom frequency mappings, primarily for testing and demonstration purposes.

classes.name: RobotSpeakTtsService
classes.description: Custom Android TextToSpeechService subclass generating robot-like synthetic speech based on character frequency mapping.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, loading preferences and default language.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onGetLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current loaded language settings.

methods.name: onIsLanguageAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a particular language and country are supported by the engine.

methods.name: onLoadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language-specific frequency data and sets internal state accordingly.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Signals the synthesis to stop processing.

methods.name: onSynthesizeText
methods.description: Synthesizes speech audio from input text, character by character, producing simplified robot-like sound.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts characters to a standard 'a'-'z' or space for consistent processing.

methods.name: buildFrequencyMap
methods.description: Constructs a mapping of characters to frequencies from loaded asset data.

methods.name: generateOneSecondOfAudio
methods.description: Creates a buffer of audio data corresponding to a character, using frequency data to generate waveforms.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Retrieves amplitude based on user preferences for whisper/normal sound.
